title: Shopping list
shops: Sun 29 Nov (Mon 30 Nov to Sun 6 Dec), Sun 6 Dec (Mon 7 to Sun 13), Sun 13 Dec (Mon 14 to Wed 16)
estimate: Everything the meals need is here, including things likely at home under "Check you have at home". Mon 30 Nov to Wed 2 Dec were shopped on 24 and 25 Nov, so those are check-at-home lines, not buys. Thu 3 to Sun 6 buys are roughly $90 to $105 (my estimate, not live prices). Anything still unticked from the old lists 1 and 2 is included at the end of each aisle.
